text: APPROVE. The pin-check and base-arm-at-pin blocks move into helpers with identical conditions, messages and cache behaviour, and the nullability flow (`headPin!`, `movedHeadPin`, `BenchArm?`) looks warning-clean. I could not see the elided middle of the method, so I couldn't confirm that nothing in the moved remainder (such as `index`) was declared there. I also couldn't build or measure the complexity, so those are inferred from the diff.
